timeline.summary: O.M. Gokul, Managing Director of Repco Home Finance, declared no encumbrance on promoter shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹453.52 Cr, net profit ₹135.18 Cr.
Repco Home Finance released its Q4FY26 investor presentation showcasing loan book growth to ₹15,880 Cr and GNPA reduction to 2.55%.
Repco Home Finance Limited hosted earnings call on May 22, 2026, sharing Q4 FY26 results and presentation via provided links, signed by Ankush Tiwari.
Repco Home Finance submitted a revised large corporate disclosure for FY26 on May 25, 2026.
Repco Home Finance hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, guiding for ₹5,000 Cr disbursements and ₹18,000 Cr AUM in FY27.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹467.7 Cr; net profit ₹121.62 Cr (+5.6% YoY).
Q1FY27 results: PAT ₹114 Cr (+5.5% YoY), loan book ₹15,990 Cr (+8.9% YoY), GNPA 2.7%
Management targets ₹5,000 Cr disbursements and 13-14% AUM growth for FY27, with a Q2 target of ₹1,200-1,250 Cr.
ICRA reaffirmed AA- (Stable) rating, enhancing rated bank term loan facilities to ₹5,000 Cr from ₹3,000 Cr.
Allotted ₹75 Cr commercial papers at 7.60% coupon to Kotak Mahindra Bank due December 2026.
ICRA assigned provisional ratings of [ICRA]AAA(SO) to ₹74.02 Cr Series A1 and [ICRA]AA(SO) to ₹3.98 Cr Equity Tranche PTCs under Pratham 09 2026.
Shareholders approved all resolutions at the 26th AGM held on 29 September 2026, including borrowing limit enhancement to ₹20,000 Cr and NCD/CP issuance limits.
Repco Home Finance Limited declared final dividend of ₹3 per share (₹10 face value) at 26th AGM on 2026-09-29 via VC/OAVM, signed by Ankush Tiwari.
